t_advice_summary_textbox.text: I will see pairs of different coloured gnomes, which will take me to different forests - light and dark. I need to figure out which gnomes take me to the most rewarding mushroom dense forests. The colour, pose and size of the gnomes is irrelevant to how many mushrooms are in the forest they lead you to.

vb_textbox.text: You will be presented with pairs of gnomes in different colours. Each coloured gnome takes you into a forest which will reward you with mushrooms. You want to collect the most mushrooms, so you need to figure out which coloured gnome provides you with the most mushrooms.Some rounds will give you a x5 multiplier so you want to collect the most on these rounds.Good Luck!
